Main memory size = 8K blocks, Cache memory size = 512 blocks, Block size = 8 words. Determine the size of tag field of the main memory address under the following conditions.

i) Fully associative mapping

ii) Direct mapping

iii) Set associative mapping with 16 blocks/set
